facts.fact: Algeria officially launched electronic signatures and certification on 16 January at a ceremony attended by the Minister of Post and Telecommunications, with ARPCE designated the national electronic certification authority, according to the ministry statement reported by We Are Tech.
ARPCE will oversee and regulate service providers offering electronic signature and certification services to the public, according to the ministry statement.

About a month before the launch, the National People's Assembly and the Governmental Electronic Certification Authority (AGCE) signed a framework agreement to integrate electronic certification and signature services.
